What to fix first
BLOCK   AGC-007 User-Enforced Data Layer                                    [Failed]
        The agent only sees data that the current user is allowed to see.
        Found: Invoice lookup does not filter by the current user
        Where: src/agent/retrieval.py:42
        Fix:   Enforce caller-specific authorization in the data service.

BLOCK   AGC-008 Vault-Injected Secrets                                      [Failed]
        Secrets come from a vault at run time and are never written in code.
        Found: Credential written in source code
        Where: src/agent/config.py:9
        Fix:   Remove the value from the code and rotate the credential.

BLOCK   AGC-010 Human Approval Gates                                        [Failed]
        A person must approve risky actions before the agent carries them out.
        Found: Refunds run without an enforced approval
        Where: src/actions.py:86
        Fix:   Require an external approval bound to the actor, the exact action, and an expiry
               time.

BLOCK   AGC-001 Owner and Inventory                                  [Declared only]
        A named person is accountable for the agent, and its tools and data are listed.
        Found: An owner is declared, but no registry record or signed attestation confirms it. The
               profile requires maturity 2.
        Where: .agentgov.yaml:4
        Fix:   Attach a signed owner attestation or a registry record as evidence.

BLOCK   AGC-004 Dedicated Non-Human Identity                                [Failed]
        The agent has its own identity and does not borrow a person's account.
        Found: Agent uses a shared service account
        Where: src/agent/config.py:14
        Fix:   Create a dedicated workload identity for the agent.
